title: Pichia pastoris transformation through electroporation
author: Igem Dusseldorf
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8heht3e
materials: Tranfer mixture to ice-cold 0.2 cm electroporation cuvette

steps.title: Linearize plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Linearize the plasmid DNA containing the gene(s) of interest using a restriction digest with an enzyme that cuts only once, following the manufacturer's manual.

steps.title: Prepare transformation mixture
steps.instruction: Mix approximately 150 ng of linearized vector DNA with electrocompetent Pichia cells in a cuvette.

steps.title: Electroporate cells
steps.instruction: Electroporate the cells using a BioRad MicroPulser with a charging voltage of 1.5 kV.

steps.title: Recover cells
steps.instruction: Immediately add 1 mL of 1:1 1 M sorbitol and YPD (v/v) to the cells to recover them.

steps.title: Incubate mixture
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a plastic culture tube and incubate at 30°C for 1 hour at 225 rpm.

steps.title: Pellet cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the culture tube at 3,000 x g for 5 min to pellet the cells.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 200 μL YPD media.

steps.title: Plate and incubate cells
steps.instruction: Plate the cells on YPDS plates containing the desired antibiotic and incubate at 30°C for 3 days.
